features.name: x001_log_normalized
features.description: Log-compressed position of x001 within the training-fold observed span, clipped to a stable 0 to 1 interval.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces skew and gives a smooth monotone input that fits a linear margin better than the raw count scale.

features.name: x002_log_normalized
features.description: Log-compressed position of x002 relative to the training-fold range from 1 to 44.
features.expected_model_benefit: Makes the smaller-valued count scale more comparable with the other inputs for margin-based weighting.

features.name: x003_log_normalized
features.description: Log-compressed position of x003 across its wide training-fold numeric span.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses the largest-scale field so extreme values remain useful without overwhelming the linear margin.

features.name: x004_range_normalized
features.description: Linear position of x004 within the training-fold observed span from 2 to 98.
features.expected_model_benefit: Places x004 on a comparable 0 to 1 scale while preserving its approximately linear ordering.

features.name: x001_share_of_pair
features.description: Smoothed proportion of x001 within the x001 plus x002 pair.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes relative balance between x001 and x002, adding a ratio-style signal that a purely additive margin may miss.

features.name: x003_per_x004_log_normalized
features.description: Log-scaled ratio of x003 to x004 with denominator smoothing and clipping to the training-fold ratio envelope.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a scale-adjusted interaction between the large-valued field and x004 while limiting leverage from extreme ratios.

features.name: x003_per_pair_log_normalized
features.description: Log-scaled x003 amount per smoothed x001 plus x002 pair magnitude.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures whether x003 is high relative to the two smaller numeric fields, creating a useful linearized interaction.

features.name: x004_per_pair_log_normalized
features.description: Log-scaled x004 amount per smoothed x001 plus x002 pair magnitude.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a relative-size feature for x004 that can reveal discordance between x004 and the two smaller fields.

features.name: weighted_centered_projection
features.description: Signed unsupervised projection of all four fields after centering by training-fold means and scaling by training-fold standard deviations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a compact linear axis summarizing joint magnitude, giving the margin an interpretable composite direction.

features.name: row_deviation_severity
features.description: Mean absolute standardized deviation from the training-fold center across all four fields.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a smooth atypicality measure that can help the margin respond to jointly unusual numeric profiles.

features.name: profile_extremeness_judgment
features.description: Numeric reviewer score from 0.0 to 1.0 for how unusual the full four-value pattern appears after comparing magnitudes and ratios with fixed training-fold ranges; 0.0 means ordinary and 1.0 means highly unusual.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a compact human-readable atypicality cue that may capture nonlinear pattern impressions not encoded by simple ratios.

features.name: scale_coherence_judgment
features.description: Numeric reviewer score from 0.0 to 1.0 for internal coherence of the four measurements; high values indicate x001, x002, x003, and x004 look mutually proportionate under the training-fold scale, while low values indicate a visibly discordant profile.
features.expected_model_benefit: Offers a smooth ordinal signal for balance versus discordance that a linear margin can combine with formula features.
